thread:
grace: Hey team — I need a one-off sudo window to pull GPU-side logs and KV cache traces for job 0x5a3f. Latency spike looks tied to an expired cache entry. Will need psql, kubectl port-forward to the inference pod, and /var/log/redwood/inference/*.log. ETA 45m. @jess can you advise on redaction requirements?

jess: Thanks for the heads-up. We need a short justification, exact commands, and an end time. Any PII in those logs? If so we require on-the-fly redaction or an approved scrub script.

grace: Justification: reproduce and capture kvcache TTL lifetime and a tokenization mismatch. Commands: `kubectl -n inference port-forward pod/inference-gtp-2 2222:22 && ssh -p 2222 root@localhost` then `sudo cat /var/log/redwood/inference/*.log | grep 0x5a3f`. I can run a scrubper if needed. No customer text expected in those logs but may include trace IDs. End time +45m from approval.

ajex: @grace please don't SSH as root. Use the jump user `infra-debug` and the ephemeral role we provision. Also prefer `rb-logfetch --job 0x5a3f --redact=pii` that wraps safe redaction. Link to runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/ephemeral-debug.

jess: That sounds better. Two quick questions: 1) Do you need DB read-only access or just read the app logs? 2) Who is the approver for this window? Security prefers owning approval for any prod-level sudo.

grace: Only app logs and kvcache dump (in-memory). No DB queries. Approver: @jess or @sam works for me.

sam: I can approve a 30m window instead of 45m. Please pin the exact start time and run `rb-logfetch --redact=pii` only. I'll approve once you confirm start time.

ops-bot: Approval workflow started. Request ID: REQ-20260305-452. Approver: sam. Please include the scrub command in the thread.

grace: Start time 2026-03-05T15:10:00Z. Command I'll run: ```rb-logfetch --job 0x5a3f --redact=pii --output /tmp/job-0x5a3f.log && sudo gcore -o /tmp/kvcache-dump $(pgrep -f inference-runtime)``` Will not pull any raw customer prompt files.

sam: Approved for 30m from 2026-03-05T15:10:00Z. Conditions: 1) Use infra-debug user. 2) Run `rb-logfetch` with `--redact=pii`. 3) Upload artifacts to secure S3 path s3://redwood-secure/forensics/REQ-20260305-452 and mark as restricted. 4) Notify sec when done. :thumbsup:

jess: Adding: enable session recording and attach to the ticket. I'll check artifacts for any accidental PII and escalate if needed.

grace: Got it — starting at 15:10Z. Will paste upload link when done. Thanks all. :lock_with_key:
